ingestion.page_numbers: PDF page numbers (1-based), not printed page numbers

retrieval.book_filtering: If a question names a book, only that book's passages are searched, using the question with book names removed.

safeguards: Refuse when the best passage scores below min_score
Refuse time-sensitive questions (latest, newest, current version, today) before generation
Keep only citation numbers that match retrieved passages; remove invented ones
Flag answers that have no valid citation as not verified
